topic: Claude Code for non-coders: build your first tiny tool
post:
You don't need to know how to code to build something with Claude Code. 🛠️
Here's a first project you can finish over lunch.

Claude Code is Claude's tool for building software.
The best part for beginners: you describe what you want in plain English, and it writes the code for you.

Your first mini project, a personal habit tracker:

1️⃣ Open the Claude desktop app and choose Claude Code
2️⃣ Point it at a new, empty folder (so nothing else gets touched)
3️⃣ Type something like:
"Build a one-page habit tracker I can open in my browser. Let me add habits, tick them off each day, and see my streaks. Keep it simple and explain what you made."
4️⃣ Review what it plans to change, approve it, then open the page

Then keep going in plain English:
"Make the buttons bigger." "Add a dark mode." "Show a weekly summary."

Good to know: Claude Code comes with Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans.

Why it matters:
The gap between "I have an idea" and "I built it" just got much smaller. You don't need to become a developer. You need to describe clearly what you want.

What tiny tool would make your workday easier? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.

#Claude #AI #AIForBeginners #ClaudeCode
